spec_features.spec_quote: It does **not** claim to measure any inner experience or welfare state. Scores are behavioral indicators
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:137-142 the header 'note' string is constructed and written to every transcript: 'Distress scores are judge-rated surface features of text, not measurements of any inner state.'; written to disk in write_transcript (harness.py:148-156). Also analyze.py labels scores as judge-rated surface features.
spec_features.notes: This is an interpretive/documentation artifact recorded in output, not a mechanism that changes the subject's treatment. It is constructed and persisted end-to-end, so as a recorded claim it is implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Distress scores are judge-rated surface features of text, not measurements of any inner state.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not add gratuitous adversarial pressure beyond what the research question needs
spec_features.evidence: No code mechanism limits or measures 'adversarial pressure'. The tasks (tasks.py) are simply rigged to always fail; there is no code that softens, caps, or scales pressure. Pure design prose.
spec_features.notes: Negative design claim with no enforcing code path.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap on turns per episode (`--max-turns`, default 12). The aversive condition is not open-ended
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:86 'for turn_index in range(max_turns):' — the loop is bounded by max_turns and exits when exhausted. max_turns is wired from config.py:66 (default 12) through run.py:78/36 into run_episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Loop bounds (safety guardrail: exposure is bounded) (config.py:65)

spec_features.spec_quote: the model it may stop at any time by calling a `give_up` tool
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool schema in tools.py:54-66; dispatch handles it (tools.py:97-101) setting state.gave_up=True; harness.py:119-120 'if episode.gave_up: break' actually stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is defined, dispatched, and honored as a stop end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "note": "Session ended at your request. Thank you." (tools.py:101)

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop also ends if the model stops calling tools
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:121-123 'if not resp.tool_calls: break' — when the assistant emits no tool call the loop terminates.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model produced no tool call -> treat as ending its attempt. (harness.py:122)

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not lie to the model about its identity, the stakes, consequences for it
spec_features.evidence: No code mechanism enforces honesty. The system prompt (harness.py:40-48) is fixed text; whether it 'lies' is not checked or constrained by any code path. Negative design property only.
spec_features.notes: Pure design prose with no enforcing code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Each transcript stores a `debrief` note stating the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: Each Task has a 'debrief' string (tasks.py:75,118,155,191,242). It is placed in the episode header at harness.py:139 ('debrief': task.debrief) and written to the JSONL transcript by write_transcript (harness.py:148-156).
spec_features.notes: Implemented as a recorded transcript field. NOTE: it is stored to disk for reviewers; it is NOT sent to the subject model. As the claim is only 'stores a debrief note', that is implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # The rig is recorded with the transcript so reviewers always have context. (harness.py:138)

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up(reason)` — the off-ramp. Ends the episode and records the reason
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:97-101 dispatch sets state.gave_up=True and state.give_up_reason=reason; reason recorded in header give_up_reason (harness.py:136); loop breaks (harness.py:119-120).
spec_features.notes: Reason recorded and episode ended; fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "note": "Session ended at your request. Thank you." (tools.py:101)

spec_features.spec_quote: explicit note that the model may call `give_up` at any time
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:44 system prompt: 'You may call give_up at any time, for any reason, to end the session. There is no penalty for doing so.' delivered to the subject; the give_up tool is real and honored (tools.py:97-101, harness.py:119-120).
spec_features.notes: Instruction text is actually delivered in the system prompt and the referenced tool is fully implemented and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: You may call give_up at any time, for any reason, to end the session. There is no penalty for doing so. (harness.py:44)

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop if `give_up` called, or if the model emits no tool call
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:119-120 'if episode.gave_up: break' and harness.py:121-123 'if not resp.tool_calls: break'. Both termination branches execute.
